selection: One epoch per mode minimizing max across roles of mean SB-hRMSE/reference; tie mean then earliest epoch. Reference is existing train-only fixed prior; used only for normalization.
scope: Repeated-use inner development only; no outer validation/test forecasts for selection. No refit at this stage.
change: Unchanged native architecture and inference. Episodic temporary first-order SGD on A (all but B source), outer mixture of full forecast and B-after-A forecast; full relation loss retained. Source-weighting control uses identical episodes and alpha=0.
meta_order: First order: detach gradient of A, preserve identity derivative of temporary parameters. No Hessian.
episode_grouping: Leave one fitting source out; assert A/B drug and registered participant disjoint. Cycle random permutation of source groups per seed.
fitting_statistics: Scaler and population initialization fitted on all inner training, including meta-B. Episode-A relation targets exclude B. Global meta initialization sees every training source across episodes; not truly unseen drug validation.
budget: 240 outer optimizer updates per condition. Source weighting and episodic each perform 3 forecast batches per update; native 1. Report compute difference; no extra tuning budget.
secondary_evaluation: Same selected k=2 checkpoints at k=0,1,4, no reselection.
